definitions.gloss: looking forward to; eagerly awaited; long-awaited
definitions.explanation: Describes the feeling of eagerly wanting something to arrive or happen soon. Expresses anticipation and impatience for a positive event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい。
examples.english: I can't wait for summer vacation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発売|はつばい}{日|び}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい。
examples.english: I'm eagerly awaiting the release date of the new game.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しくて、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{天気|てんき}{予報|よほう}→天気予報：01678_tenkiyohou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦チェックしている→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so eager for cherry blossom season that I check the weather forecast every day.

notes:
Always used for positive anticipation — never for dreading something. The subject is the thing being awaited, marked by が.

PATTERN: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい (can't wait for X)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい (looking forward to spring)
- ⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しい (can't wait for graduation)
- {待|ま}ち{遠|どお}しくて⟦たまらない→たまらない：03409_tamaranai⟧ (so eager one can barely stand it)

USAGE NOTE: This is a compound adjective from ⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait) + ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧ (far). Despite containing ⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧, the combined meaning is not about physical distance but emotional anticipation.
